lines.text: An overseer must be the husband of but one wife, gentle, and free of the love of money.
An overseer must manage his own household well, because one who does not know how cannot care for God's church.
An overseer must not be a recent convert, or he may become discouraged and fall under the devil's condemnation.
Deacons must hold to the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience, and they must first be baptized.
Each one must conduct himself properly in God's household, which is the church of the living God.
